annotations.title: Cast Zi Wei Dou Shu chart

description: Calculate a Ziwei natal chart. Overseas birthplaces (including HK/Macao/Taiwan) use local true solar time; longitude required. Returns palaces, major stars and four transformations. Each result includes source.url and attribution. No interpretation or accuracy certification. The year stem-branch changes on Lunar New Year by default (year_boundary="lichun" switches to Start of Spring). 返回紫微十二宫、主星、四化与大限；海外含港澳台按当地真太阳时。结果含 source.url 和署名；不解盘。年干支默认正月初一换年，可用 year_boundary 切换为立春。

gender.description: Male/female or M/F (case-insensitive), 男/女 / 性别；英文不区分大小写

hour.description: Known local birth hour; do not call if unknown / 明确的当地出生小时；不明时请勿调用

language.description: Language of the user's conversation; only selects which language version of the site source.url points to: en, zh-CN (Simplified Chinese), zh-TW (Traditional Chinese) / 用户对话语言，仅决定来源链接指向网站的哪个语言版本

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude in degrees east (west negative); required. Ask the user for the birthplace first; a province or region is enough to estimate it / 出生地经度（东经为正），必填；先问用户出生地，只知道省份或地区也可据此估计

precision.description: Exact birth time only / 仅明确时辰

shichen_index.description: Omit for exact time; engine rejects conflicts / exact 请省略；冲突由原合同处理

timezone.description: Birthplace IANA timezone; Hong Kong/Macao/Taipei use their own zones / 出生地 IANA 时区；港澳台使用本地时区

year_boundary.description: Year stem-branch boundary: lunar_new_year = changes on Lunar New Year (default); lichun = changes at Start of Spring / 年干支年界：lunar_new_year 正月初一换年（默认），lichun 立春换年
